#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Manual sanity check for rotate.sh beyond the new unit test.
set -uo pipefail
root="/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakfp21-d"
t=$(mktemp -d)
d="$t/d"
mkdir -p "$d"
for s in 20260101-010000 20260101-020000 20260101-030000 20260101-040000; do
  : > "$d/app-$s.tar.gz"
  : > "$d/app-$s.tar.gz.sha256"
done
echo "-- rotate --keep 2 of 4 (expect oldest two deleted, sidecars with them) --"
bash "$root/rotate.sh" --dest "$d" --name app --keep 2
echo "-- remaining --"
ls "$d" | sort
echo "-- dry run at exactly keep count (expect nothing to rotate) --"
bash "$root/rotate.sh" --dest "$d" --name app --keep 2
echo "-- flags still accepted: --keep=3, -n, --dry-run, --quiet, --help exit codes --"
bash "$root/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest="$d" --name=app --keep=3 --dry-run
bash "$root/rotate.sh" --dest "$d" --name app -n -q
rc=0; bash "$root/rotate.sh" --dest "$d" --name app --keep 0 2>/dev/null || rc=$?
echo "keep=0 rc=$rc (expect 1)"
rc=0; bash "$root/rotate.sh" --dest "$d" 2>/dev/null || rc=$?
echo "missing --name rc=$rc (expect 1)"
bash "$root/rotate.sh" --help > /dev/null
echo "help rc=$? (expect 0)"
rm -rf "$t"

result:
Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh`.

Details:

- **rotate.sh bug** — `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"` on the oldest-first list, which deletes from the *keep*-th entry to the end; with exactly N archives that line is the newest, so it got deleted. Now the guard is `total -le keep` (nothing to rotate) and surplus is `head -n "$((total - keep))"` — the oldest `total - keep` entries, so the newest `keep` survive.
- **verify.sh bug** — the sidecar line was split with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating names with spaces to their first word ("my") → "archive missing" → BAD/rc=2. Now `read -r expected file <<< "$line"` keeps the whole remainder of the line as the file name; the malformed-sidecar check (digest-only line → empty file) is preserved.
- **Shared code** — new `lib/common.sh` holds the option parser as `parse_common_options` (sets `DEST`/`NAME`/`KEEP`/`QUIET`/`DRY_RUN`/`ARGS`, validates `--keep`) plus `is_uint`, `need_value` and `resolve_dir`, with a double-source guard like `lib/log.sh`. `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it and call `parse_common_options "$@"` — all flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `=` forms, `-n`, `-q`, `--help`, `--`, and `parse_local_option` dispatch) behave as before, verified by hand runs. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` and `report.sh` are untouched.
- **Tests** — two new checks in `tests/run_tests.sh`: one that `--keep 3` with exactly 3 archives deletes nothing (newest kept), one that an archive named `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` verifies `ok` with rc=0. `bash tests/run_tests.sh`: all 8 tests pass.

One note: my two throwaway sanity-check scripts in `.scratch/` are still there — my shell `rm` was blocked by permissions; approve a delete or remove them manually.
